rationale: The agent ran tools to look up the user and two orders and then modified the default address. However, there is no visible authentication interaction beyond using name/ZIP, no explicit confirmation prior to performing a write (changing the default address), and—critically—no evidence in the conversation that the agent actually provided the user with the requested information (shipping address used, tracking numbers, in-transit status, or tablet storage). The only displayed assistant text is a brief sign-off, so the completion of the user’s requests cannot be verified. Given missing confirmation for a write and lack of demonstrated fulfillment of the requested details, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
